exact_statement: For every independent indicator A and Boolean core split with BOTH child means zero, with p=EA, J(A)=I(1-2A)/2 and delta=Pr(g_+!=g_-), the activated split F_+=1+A(g_+-1), F_-=1+A(g_--1) satisfies B_i(F)=pB_i(g), d_i(F)=pdelta and I(F_+F_-)/2=pI(g_+g_-)/2+delta J(A). For t balanced bent_m/zero-flip selector seed copies and any selector/control-only adaptive prefix retaining bent data and balance signs and processing every selector unless A is identically zero, its strictly bad-selector credit (when B_selector>K2^-m) is 2^-m[m t p+sum_selector_v w_v J(A_v)], while I(F)=p t[1+m/2+(m+1)2^-m]+J(A). A proposed full-tree Q_bad<=L I therefore necessarily bounds the displayed residual-boundary exposure by L2^m I(F)-m t p; this is sufficient only for the selector contribution. Control queries telescope J; selectors leave it unchanged. For every union of positive point events, density and J equal inclusion-exclusion over union-coordinate sizes, including duplicated events. The actual controller A=x1x2 OR x1x3 OR x0x2x3 has p=7/16,J=3/4 and its x0 query in 1+A(g-1) has d=1/16 and B>4d for ANY independent balanced core; with g=z this is a five-bit Boolean witness. Permuting labels refutes zero-badness for any function-independent control order. Exactly all 680 triples-with-repetition of nonempty positive point events on four controls admit a control-only stopping tree with zero strictly 4-bad control nodes for every balanced core: 677 use (0,1,2,3), and the three exceptional triples (6,10,13),(6,11,12),(7,10,12) use (1,0,2,3), each having 18 zero-bad orders among 24. The finite-domain stopping ledger retains terminal pH(g), giving H(1+A(g-1))<=(4+2/ln2)J(A)+pH(g). No arbitrary-width or full-FEI selection claim is made.
